title: Loving, Helping Hands
traveler_why: Tonight is a story about caring hands, and Willow the Warm is the Traveler who notices someone is tired before she is asked to.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she loves to care for others like the kind woman in the song. In Willow’s world today: Willow noticed Mom was tired after a long day. So Willow used her helping hands — she put her toys away without being asked and brought Mom a pretend cup of tea. Mom’s face lit up. “Thank you, my helper!” Just like the loving woman whose family called her blessed, Willow learned that caring hands make a home warm.
